name: Eagan Peltskinner
summary: Timber wolves threaten Northshire Valley, and Eagan Peltskinner has work for recruits outside the abbey. The local furrier needs hunters to thin the packs and bring back pelts.

sections.title: A Word with the Furrier
sections.body: Deputy Willem often sends abbey recruits to find Eagan Peltskinner on the nearby grounds. Northshire Valley's orchards and fields meet wild woods where timber wolves prowl. Eagan asks newcomers to hunt the aggressive packs and gather pelts for his craft.

sections.title: Trouble on the Perimeter
sections.body: Timber wolves threaten workers, acolytes, and supplies traveling to and from Northshire. Sending young champions to Eagan helps keep nearby paths safe and leaves Stormwind's few remaining guards free for other duties. Those guards are already occupied by rising tensions across Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Eagan Peltskinner?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem sends promising recruits to Eagan after telling them about the valley's security concerns. He waits outside Northshire Abbey's entrance.
Eagan Peltskinner works near Northshire Abbey's outer walls, around the left side of the main building, among his drying racks and gear.

faq.q: What does Eagan Peltskinner need help with?
faq.answer: Eagan needs a hunter to kill aggressive timber wolves in the surrounding woods and bring back their pelts. This helps clear Northshire's perimeter.

faq.q: Can you skip this quest and talk to Eagan directly?
faq.answer: Yes. Eagan offers hunting work to anyone who approaches him. Speaking with him first means you miss Deputy Willem's introduction.

faq.q: Why are there so many wolves in Northshire Valley?
faq.answer: Northshire Valley borders dense, untamed woodlands where timber wolves roam freely. Local guards are stretched thin by other threats across the kingdom, leaving the predators unchecked.

faq.q: What task follows speaking with Eagan Peltskinner?
faq.answer: After speaking with Eagan, you are asked to hunt timber wolves beyond the abbey grounds and collect their tough pelts.

angles.text: Every small task in Northshire helps secure Stormwind's home territory while the kingdom's core army remains stretched thin elsewhere.
As a young human leaving Northshire Abbey, you first learn to defend your homeland by helping local tradesfolk like Eagan.
